fields.description: X-62A VISTA is a one-of-a-kind variable in-flight simulation test aircraft developed by Lockheed Martin Skunk Works with Calspan for the U.S. Air Force Test Pilot School at Edwards Air Force Base. Previously designated NF-16D, it was formally redesignated X-62A VISTA in June 2021. Its open systems architecture, Model Following Algorithm and System for Autonomous Control of the Simulation let it mimic other aircraft and support third-party AI and autonomy testing. Calspan operates the aircraft for the Test Pilot School and calls it the most capable in-flight simulator in the world. No numeric price, mass, dimensions, payload, speed, endurance, IP rating or navigation accuracy is published.

fields.description: SAM is a mobile UV-C room-disinfection robot. It disinfects a room, including the bathroom, in a single autonomous run without mapping or manual repositioning; staff push it between rooms and start cycles from a tablet in five steps. Reports upload automatically to a disinfection portal. Loop Robots says a typical cGMP class B, C or D cleanroom of 25 m² is decontaminated in 15 minutes with non-chemical, dry UV-C light that leaves no residue. The pages publish no numeric price, mass, dimensions, battery endurance, runtime, speed, IP rating or navigation accuracy.

fields.description: The Lucid Gravity Robotaxi is a purpose-built autonomous ride-hailing vehicle developed by Lucid, Nuro and Uber. It is based on Lucid’s all-electric Gravity SUV and uses the Nuro Driver with a 360-degree sensor array of high-resolution cameras, lidar and radars integrated into the body and a roof-mounted Halo module. NVIDIA DRIVE AGX Thor provides real-time AI compute; a Halo LED display shows passenger initials and trip status, and interactive screens control seats, climate and music. The layout fits up to six passengers with luggage space. Nuro, Lucid and Uber announced autonomous on-road testing at CES 2026, a 2026 launch in a major U.S. city and Houston service in 2027; they plan 20,000 or more vehicles and cite up to 450 miles of range. No numeric price, mass, dimensions, battery endurance, runtime, speed, IP rating or navigation accuracy is published.

fields.description: Flippy is Miso Robotics’ AI-powered robotic fry station for commercial kitchens. It works with existing Frymaster, Henny Penny and Pitco fryers, starts at 9.5 ft of wall space and is installed under an existing hood and Ansul system. The manufacturer claims 100 baskets per hour versus 50 for human workers, automatic food recognition, real-time cook monitoring and doneness adjustment, multiple-basket management and basket agitation. Miso says new menu items can be learned in five to seven days and that installations typically complete overnight within 90 days. Flippy is NSF certified, UL 763 tested, and described as operable by all staff without restriction. No numeric price, mass, dimensions, speed, battery endurance, runtime, IP rating or navigation accuracy is published.
